_about: Observational numbers and literature results for the six thesis calculations (docs/thesis-plan.md). Collected 2026-09-28 by a research pass over the primary sources; every entry has its source. 'verified': false means the number could not be confirmed from the primary text and must be checked before citing. Conventions: Omega_K > 0 is OPEN; Planck units G = hbar = c = 1 where marked; m_Pl = 1.22e19 GeV, reduced M_Pl = m_Pl/sqrt(8 pi) = 2.435e18 GeV.

n_s_act_dr6.note: Starobinsky gives 0.964-0.967 for N=55-60: 2-3 sigma tension if ACT holds

phi2_excluded.source: Planck 2018 X: monomials p >= 2 strongly disfavoured

lqc_prob_slow_roll_phi2.note: Liouville measure on the bounce surface; |phi_B| <= phi_max with m*phi_max = 0.90 m_Pl^2

brady_smith_1995.note: late-time metric function ~ e^{-gamma v}, gamma ~ kappa_- within ~10%; m reaches ~1e50

burko_1997.note: Psi_v ratio -> 1 within 2e-3 at v=600; g_UV finite at CH (weak singularity)

oren_piran_2003.note: r_v ∝ v^-2 on CH; Q_H/M_H < 1 as Q0/M0 -> 2

RN_zilberman_levi_ori_2020.note: <T_uu>,<T_vv> finite at IH in Eddington coords -> T_VV ∝ e^{2 kappa_- v}; positive below the flip (contraction); backreaction ∝ (m_P/M)^2

hollands_wald_zahn_2020.statement: T_VV ~ C/V^2 at the Cauchy horizon for any Hadamard state; C generically nonzero

planck_race_estimate.note: order-of-magnitude, solar mass; classical mass inflation reaches Planck curvature first unless the classical tail is tiny — to be computed in L1d

lmyz_inner_horizon.statement: r_-^3 ≈ alpha M/2; bounce radius R_b^3 = alpha M/2 lies inside r_- by R_b/(6M); kappa_- ≈ 3M/r_-^2
lmyz_inner_horizon.source: Cao, Li, Wu & Zhou 2024, EPJC 84, 507, arXiv:2308.10746; relations re-derived 2026-09-30

cao_2024_mass_inflation.statement: mass inflation always occurs at the LMYZ inner horizon (test fields + DTR, static background)

hksw_2022_no_mass_inflation.statement: dynamical effective-LQG LTB dust collapse: no mass inflation (single-stream dust cannot counter-stream)

bks_2021.statement: Ori model: Hayward/RG-improved metrics give polynomial mass inflation, RN/Bardeen exponential

carballo_rubio_2021.statement: Misner–Sharp mass always has an exponential phase at an inner horizon

RN_coulomb_turning_point.note: any radial marginally bound matter turns around inside r_- in RN; the Kerr axis has no turning point — RN cannot test the LQC bounce of the axial seed

kappa_matching.note: Kerr a* ↔ RN Q/M with equal kappa_- M; maps the Kerr polar flux sign flips onto the RN ones (0.965–0.968) — unpublished coincidence check
